q: After rising from the dead, for how many days did Jesus appear to His apostles?
why: He spoke about the kingdom of God.
quote: He appeared to them over a span of forty days

q: Before going up to heaven, which city did Jesus tell His apostles not to leave?
why: They were to wait for the Father's gift.
quote: Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised

q: Before going up to heaven, Jesus said His apostles would soon be baptized with what?
quote: in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

q: Before going up to heaven, what did Jesus say His apostles would receive when the Spirit came?
quote: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you

q: Before going up to heaven, how far did Jesus say His witnesses would go?
a: To the ends of the earth
why: The good news is for everyone.
quote: and to the ends of the earth.

q: As Jesus was taken up into heaven, what hid Him from the apostles' sight?
quote: they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.

q: After Jesus went up to heaven, what did the two men in white promise?
a: He will come back the same way
quote: will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.

q: On which feast day were the believers all together when the Holy Spirit came?
quote: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

q: On the day of Pentecost, what sound came from heaven and filled the house?
quote: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven

q: On the day of Pentecost, what came to rest on each believer?
why: It was a sign of the Spirit.
quote: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

q: On the day of Pentecost, after being filled with the Spirit, what did the believers do?
quote: began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

q: On the day of Pentecost, why was the crowd in Jerusalem amazed?
quote: because each one heard them speaking his own language.

q: On the day of Pentecost, which apostle stood up and spoke to the crowd?
quote: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd

q: About how many people were baptized after Peter's sermon at Pentecost?
quote: about three thousand were added to the believers that day.

q: In the first church in Jerusalem, what did the believers devote themselves to?
why: These were the habits of the first church.
quote: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

q: How did the first believers in Jerusalem treat what they owned?
quote: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

q: In the first church, why did believers sell their possessions?
a: To share with anyone in need
why: No one was left in need.
quote: they shared with anyone who was in need.

q: In the first church in Jerusalem, how often did believers meet in the temple courts?
why: They broke bread in their homes too.
quote: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts

q: Where did the first believers break bread together?
quote: and to break bread from house to house

q: In the first church, who added to their number daily?
quote: And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

q: In the first church, what came over everyone as the apostles did wonders?
why: God was at work among them.
quote: A sense of awe came over everyone

q: At which temple gate did the man lame from birth sit and beg?
why: He was put there every day.
quote: the temple gate called Beautiful

q: Who was going up to the temple with Peter when they met the lame man?
why: It was the hour of prayer.
quote: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer

q: What did the lame man at the temple gate ask Peter and John for?
quote: he asked them for money.

q: What did Peter say he did not have to give the lame man?
quote: Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you

q: In whose name did Peter tell the lame man to get up and walk?
why: The power was Jesus', not Peter's.
quote: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!

q: How did Peter help the lame man at the temple gate up?
a: Took him by the right hand
why: At once his feet grew strong.
quote: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up

q: After Peter healed him, what did the lame man do in the temple courts?
quote: walking and leaping and praising God.

q: When the church chose seven helpers, who was described as full of faith and the Holy Spirit?
why: He was the first named of the seven.
quote: They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit

q: Stephen, one of the seven chosen helpers, was full of grace and what else?
why: He did great wonders and signs.
quote: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power

q: Before he was stoned, whom did Stephen see standing at God's right hand?
quote: I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.

q: When Stephen was stoned, at whose feet did the witnesses lay their garments?
quote: the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

q: While he was being stoned, what did Stephen pray?
why: He trusted Jesus to the end.
quote: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

q: What did Stephen ask God about the people who were stoning him?
a: Do not hold this sin against them
quote: Lord, do not hold this sin against them.

q: What broke out against the church on the day Stephen died?
quote: On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem

q: Who told Philip to go to the desert road toward Gaza?
why: God had someone for him to meet.
quote: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road

q: On the desert road to Gaza, whom did Philip meet?
why: He was in charge of a queen's treasury.
quote: on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official

q: Which prophet was the Ethiopian official reading in his chariot?
quote: was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.

q: What did Philip ask the Ethiopian official reading in his chariot?
a: Do you understand what you're reading?
quote: “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.

q: The Ethiopian official read a scripture about someone led like what to the slaughter?
why: Philip explained it was about Jesus.
quote: He was led like a sheep to the slaughter

q: When they came to some water, what did Philip do for the Ethiopian official?
why: The official believed the good news.
quote: Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

q: After his baptism, how did the Ethiopian official go on his way?
why: He had found the good news.
quote: but went on his way rejoicing.

q: To which city was Saul traveling to arrest followers of Jesus?
why: He carried letters from the high priest.
quote: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus

q: On the road to Damascus, what suddenly flashed around Saul?
why: Jesus was about to speak to him.
quote: suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

q: On the road to Damascus, what did the voice from heaven ask Saul?
quote: Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?

q: When Saul asked, “Who are You, Lord?” on the road, who answered?
quote: I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting

q: After meeting Jesus on the road to Damascus, how long was Saul blind?
why: He did not eat or drink.
quote: For three days he was without sight

q: Which disciple in Damascus placed his hands on blind Saul?
why: The Lord sent him in a vision.
quote: So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul.

q: When Ananias prayed for Saul in Damascus, what fell from Saul's eyes?
quote: something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes

q: Which king put Peter in prison during the Feast of Unleavened Bread?
quote: He arrested him and put him in prison

q: While Herod kept Peter in prison, what was the church doing?
quote: but the church was fervently praying to God for him.

q: On the night before his trial under Herod, how was Peter sleeping?
why: He was bound with two chains.
quote: Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains

q: When the angel woke Peter in Herod's prison, what fell off his wrists?
quote: And the chains fell off his wrists.

q: As the angel led Peter out of prison, how did the iron gate open?
quote: came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself.

q: After escaping prison, who answered when Peter knocked at the house gate?
quote: a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.

q: When Rhoda heard Peter's voice at the gate, what did she forget to do?
quote: she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate

q: Who was beaten and thrown into prison with Paul in Philippi?
quote: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas

q: In the Philippian prison, what were Paul's and Silas's feet fastened in?
why: They were in the inner cell.
quote: he placed them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.

q: What were Paul and Silas doing in prison about midnight?
quote: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God

q: While Paul and Silas sang in prison, what shook the prison's foundations?
quote: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the foundations of the prison.

q: When the jailer was about to kill himself, what did Paul shout?
quote: Do not harm yourself! We are all here!

q: What did the Philippian jailer ask Paul and Silas?
a: What must I do to be saved?
quote: Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

q: What did Paul and Silas tell the jailer he must do to be saved?
why: His household could be saved too.
quote: Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.

q: To which country was Paul sailing as a prisoner when the great storm struck?
why: He was going to stand before Caesar.
quote: When it was decided that we would sail for Italy

q: In the great storm on Paul's ship, what did not appear for many days?
quote: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days

q: During the storm at sea, who stood beside Paul in the night?
why: He brought a message of hope.
quote: For just last night an angel of God, whose I am and whom I serve, stood beside me

q: During the storm, what did Paul say would be the only loss?
quote: you will not experience any loss of life, but only of the ship.

q: When Paul's ship broke up, how many people reached land safely?
quote: In this way everyone was brought safely to land.

q: On which island did Paul land after the shipwreck?
quote: we learned that the island was called Malta.

q: After the shipwreck, what fastened onto Paul's hand by the fire?
why: He shook it off and was not hurt.
quote: a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself to his hand.

q: Who was chosen by lot to replace Judas as an apostle?
quote: and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

q: From which mountain did the apostles return after Jesus went up to heaven?
quote: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives

q: After Jesus went up to heaven, where did the apostles stay in Jerusalem?
quote: they went to the upper room where they were staying

q: At Pentecost, what did Peter tell the crowd to do?
why: They would receive the Holy Spirit.
quote: Repent and be baptized, every one of you

q: Peter said salvation is found in no other name except whose?
why: Peter was speaking of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.
quote: Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.

q: The leaders saw Peter and John were ordinary men but noticed they had been with whom?
why: Time with Jesus made them bold.
quote: and took note that these men had been with Jesus.

q: What does the name Barnabas mean?
why: The apostles gave him this name.
quote: whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement)

q: By secretly keeping back money from the land, whom did Peter say Ananias had lied to?
why: Lying to the church was lying to God.
quote: how is it that Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit

q: How did Saul's disciples help him escape from Damascus?
why: They let him down through the wall.
quote: lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.

q: In which city were believers in Jesus first given the name Christians?
why: Barnabas and Saul taught there a year.
quote: The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.

q: By what other name was Saul also called?
why: He is best known by this name.
quote: Then Saul, who was also called Paul

q: Who was Cornelius, the God-fearing man in Caesarea?
why: He was in the Italian Regiment.
quote: a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.

q: In Peter's vision of the sheet, what did the voice say about what God made clean?
quote: Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.

q: At Cornelius's house, what did Peter say he now truly understood about God?
quote: I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism

q: Which apostle did King Herod put to death with the sword?
quote: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

q: When Rhoda said Peter was at the gate, what did the praying believers say?
a: You are out of your mind
why: They found it hard to believe.
quote: “You are out of your mind,” they told her.

q: After parting with Barnabas, whom did Paul choose as his new partner?
quote: but Paul chose Silas and left

q: In Philippi, what did Lydia sell?
quote: a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth

q: After believing, what did the Philippian jailer do for Paul and Silas that night?
why: Then he and his household were baptized.
quote: At that hour of the night, the jailer took them and washed their wounds.

q: In Athens, what was written on the altar Paul found?
why: Paul told them about the true God.
quote: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.

q: What trade did Paul share with Aquila and Priscilla?
quote: because they were tentmakers by trade, just as he was.

q: Which young man fell asleep and fell from a window while Paul preached?
quote: a certain young man named Eutychus, seated in the window, was sinking into a deep sleep

q: Paul quoted the Lord Jesus: it is more blessed to give than to do what?
quote: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

q: On Malta, what did Paul do with the viper that bit his hand?
a: Shook it off into the fire
quote: But Paul shook the creature off into the fire and suffered no ill effects.

q: How did Paul live during his two years in Rome?
quote: Paul stayed there two full years in his own rented house

q: About how many believers were gathered when Peter stood up to choose Judas's replacement?
quote: (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty)

q: Besides Matthias, who was the other man proposed to replace Judas?
why: He was also known as Justus.
quote: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

q: At what hour of prayer did Peter and John go up to the temple and heal the lame man?
quote: at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

q: After the lame man was healed, where did the astonished people run to Peter and John?
quote: the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade.

q: Barnabas was a Levite from which island?
quote: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus

q: The Ethiopian official was in charge of the treasury of which queen?
why: She was queen of the Ethiopians.
quote: in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians.

q: On which street in Damascus was Saul staying when Ananias came?
why: He was at the house of Judas.
quote: Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street

q: Saul of the Damascus road came from which city?
why: The Lord named it to Ananias.
quote: a man from Tarsus named Saul

q: How many squads of soldiers did Herod use to guard Peter in prison?
quote: handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each.

q: After escaping prison, Peter went to the house of Mary, the mother of whom?
quote: he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark

q: In Lystra, the crowd called Paul Hermes. What did they call Barnabas?
quote: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes

q: Lydia, the seller of purple cloth, came from which city?
why: She listened to Paul in Philippi.
quote: a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira

q: How many people were on board Paul's ship before the shipwreck?
quote: In all, there were 276 of us on board.

q: What was the name of the centurion who guarded Paul on the voyage to Italy?
why: He belonged to the Imperial Regiment.
quote: were handed over to a centurion named Julius

q: In Ephesus, what did former magicians burn in front of everyone?
why: They were worth fifty thousand drachmas.
quote: brought their books and burned them in front of everyone.

q: Which king asked Paul, “Can you persuade me in such a short time to become a Christian?”
why: Paul was on trial before him.
quote: Then Agrippa said to Paul
